description: A Helper Electrician is responsible for helping the construction electrician and performing tasks under instructions and supervision. The responsibilities also include performing preparatory works before temporary and permanent electrical installations and handling tools, devices, and materials used to perform electrical works.
awardingBodyName: CONSTRUCTION SKILL DEVELOPMENT COUNCIL OF INDIA
typeOfQualification: General, Fresh Skilling, For ToT, For ToA, Future Skills

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Work according to personal health, safety and environment protocols at construction site
Work effectively in a team to deliver desired results at the workplace
Erect and dismantle temporary scaffold up to 3.6 meter height
Carry out wall chasing and external threading on MS (Mild Steel) conduit
Handle different tools, measuring devices and materials relevant to LV (low voltage) electrical works

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.PREVNSQFLEVELSACHIEVED: Previous relevant Qualification of NSQF Level 1
